turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You already use words like yesterday and last weekend. They tell us an action is finished.
Let me solve one: "Every day I walk to work. Yesterday I (walk) to work." Yesterday means finished, so I add -ed: Yesterday I walked to work.
Rule: for most action words, add -ed when the action is finished.
Right: Last night she cleaned the kitchen.
Wrong: Last night she clean the kitchen.
Now you. Write the past form: Last Friday I (help) my friend.
